top_signals.title: Electric Supercars Are Getting Faster, Smarter, and Harder to Ignore
top_signals.summary: Electric vehicle (EV) and hybrid sales continue to rise, particularly in regions such as Europe and Asia, as people shift away from internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles toward cleaner alternatives. However, there has long been a stigma surrounding high-end EVs and electric supercars, with most consumers sticking to the ICE versions. Now, several well-known automakers are offering hybrid and electric versions of their sports or high-end cars with impressive range and speeds, which are catching the eyes of a growing number of consumers.
